section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The Preparedness team conducts research, evaluations, monitoring, forecasting, and continuous updating of the Scorecard with input from teams that have relevant domain expertise.
paraphrase: The Preparedness team performs research, evaluations, monitoring, forecasting, and Scorecard updates with input from relevant domain experts.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The Safety Advisory Group (SAG), including the SAG Chair, provides a diversity of perspectives to evaluate the strength of evidence related to catastrophic risk and recommend appropriate actions.
paraphrase: The SAG, including its Chair, evaluates evidence of catastrophic risk and recommends appropriate actions.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The SAG will strive to recommend mitigations that are as targeted and non-disruptive as possible while not compromising safety.
paraphrase: The SAG aims to recommend mitigations that are targeted and minimally disruptive without compromising safety.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: In particular, we recognize that pausing deployment or development would be the last resort (but potentially necessary) option in these circumstances
paraphrase: Pausing deployment or development is recognized as a last-resort but potentially necessary option.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The members of the SAG and the SAG Chair are appointed by the OpenAI Leadership. This will be done in consultation with the BoD, as is common for important roles in general.
paraphrase: OpenAI Leadership appoints SAG members and the SAG Chair, in consultation with the Board.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: SAG membership will rotate yearly. OpenAI leadership might choose to re-appoint someone from previous years to ensure there is continuity of knowledge and experience, while still ensuring that fresh and timely perspectives are present in the group.
paraphrase: SAG membership rotates annually, though leadership may re-appoint prior members for continuity while keeping fresh perspectives.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The SAG Chair makes any final decisions needed for the SAG. This role is expected to rotate, as appointed by OpenAI leadership.
paraphrase: The SAG Chair makes final SAG decisions, and this role is expected to rotate as appointed by leadership.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The OpenAI Leadership, i.e., the CEO or a person designated by them, serves as the default decision-maker on all decisions
paraphrase: OpenAI Leadership, meaning the CEO or their designee, is the default decision-maker for all decisions.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The OpenAI Board of Directors (BoD), as the ultimate governing body of OpenAI, will oversee OpenAI Leadership’s implementation and decision-making pursuant to this Preparedness Framework.
paraphrase: The Board of Directors, as the ultimate governing body, will oversee Leadership's implementation of the Framework.

section_heading: Parties in the Preparedness Framework operationalization process
excerpt: The BoD may review certain decisions taken and will receive appropriate documentation (i.e., without needing to proactively ask) to ensure the BOD is fully informed and able to fulfill its oversight role
paraphrase: The Board may review decisions and automatically receives documentation to stay informed and fulfill its oversight role.

excerpt: The Preparedness team is responsible for:
paraphrase: This introduces a list of Preparedness team responsibilities.

context_stem: The Preparedness team is responsible for:
excerpt: maintaining and updating the Scorecard, including designing and running evaluations to provide Scorecard inputs and collecting relevant information on monitored misuse, red-teaming, and intelligence
paraphrase: Responsibility: maintain and update the Scorecard, run evaluations, and collect information on misuse, red-teaming, and intelligence.

context_stem: The Preparedness team is responsible for:
excerpt: monitoring for unknown unknowns and making the case for inclusion in the Preparedness Framework of any new risk categories as they emerge
paraphrase: Responsibility: monitor for unknown unknowns and propose adding new risk categories as they arise.

context_stem: The Preparedness team is responsible for:
excerpt: ensuring the risk level distinctions in the Tracked Risk Categories section are appropriate given developments in frontier AI models, and suggesting updates to these levels if needed
paraphrase: Responsibility: ensure risk level distinctions remain appropriate given AI developments and suggest updates as needed.

context_stem: The Preparedness team is responsible for:
excerpt: forecasting potential changes to catastrophic risk levels, and summarizing evidence for an “early warning” / “heads up” as needed
paraphrase: Responsibility: forecast potential catastrophic risk changes and summarize evidence for early warnings as needed.
